draft: Our trade receivables stand at Rs 920.00 Lakhs, representing 19.09% of our revenue for the year ending 2026. Any delay in payment or default by our customers could significantly increase our working capital requirements and adversely affect our cash flows and overall liquidity. If we experience prolonged delays in the collection of these receivables, our financial condition and operations may be materially and adversely affected, as we rely on timely realizations to fund our ongoing business activities.
